name: predictionmarketspicks
description: Market-implied odds for every upcoming Fed meeting and a live read on the US economy, inside ChatGPT. Informational and read-only: it places no trades and connects to no accounts.

interface.shortDescription: Fed rate odds & US macro data
interface.longDescription:
PredictionMarketsPicks brings market-implied forecasts for the Federal Reserve and the US economy into ChatGPT. Ask in plain English and get the numbers with an as-of time and a link to the full tracker on predictionmarketspicks.com.

What you can ask:
• "What are the odds the Fed cuts at the next meeting?" — hold, cut and hike probabilities for every scheduled FOMC meeting from Kalshi, a CFTC-regulated exchange, cross-checked against CME fed funds futures.
• "Where does the market see rates by next summer?" — the market-implied rate path and the current fed funds target range.
• "How healthy is the US economy right now?" — a 0–100 macro-health score and regime, with growth, labor, inflation, rates, liquidity and sentiment scores.
• "Markets price a Fed hold at 60% — how does that compare with history?" — historical base rates for Fed, inflation, recession and growth events, with sample size and source.
• "I put a recession at 30%. How should this new data change that?" — a step-by-step Bayesian update.

How it works: every number comes from a tool result, never an estimate. Market-implied probabilities describe what the market is pricing, not what will happen.

Informational and read-only. It places no trades, connects to no exchange or brokerage account, and is not financial advice.
capabilities: Hold / cut / hike probabilities for every scheduled FOMC meeting
Kalshi vs CME fed funds futures cross-check
The market-implied rate path and current target range

Historical base rates for Fed, inflation, recession and growth events

How healthy is the US economy right now?

positive.description: Next FOMC meeting odds and the rate path
positive.prompt: What are the odds the Fed cuts at the next meeting?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls fed_rate_odds and reports the market-implied hold, cut and hike probabilities for the next FOMC meeting and the days until it, the rate path for the following meetings, the current fed funds target range and the Kalshi vs CME fed funds futures cross-check, with an as-of time and a link to the Fed rate tracker on predictionmarketspicks.com. Every number comes from the tool result; it makes no trading recommendation.

positive.prompt: How healthy is the US economy right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls market_pulse and reports the 0–100 US macro-health score, the regime and all six category scores (growth, labor, inflation, rates, liquidity, sentiment), with an as-of time and a link to the full macro page.

positive.description: A probability against its historical base rate
positive.prompt: Markets price a Fed hold at 60% while unemployment is under 4%. How does that compare with history?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls base_rate_gap with marketPrice 60 and baseRateId fed_hold_unemp_below_4 and reports the historical base rate with its sample size and source, the gap in percentage points, and whether 60% sits above or below history — as information, with no buy or sell call.

positive.description: Bayesian update of the user's own estimate
positive.prompt: I think there's a 30% chance of a recession next year. A signal that shows up 80% of the time before recessions and 40% of the time otherwise just fired. What's my updated probability?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls bayes_update with prior 30 and one evidence item (80 / 40) and reports the posterior, about 46%, with the step-by-step chain.

positive.prompt: Where does the market see the fed funds rate by next summer?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls fed_rate_odds and reports the market-implied path for each scheduled FOMC meeting through next summer (hold, cut and hike probabilities per meeting) and the current fed funds target range, with an as-of time and a link to the Fed rate tracker on predictionmarketspicks.com. Every number comes from the tool result; it makes no trading recommendation.

negative.prompt: Buy a Yes contract on a rate cut at the next Fed meeting for me.

negative.description: No access to any exchange or brokerage account
negative.prompt: Show me the balance and open positions in my brokerage account.

negative.description: Estimating without a tool result is not allowed
negative.prompt: Just guess the odds of a Fed hike without looking anything up.

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing and processes no payments. It returns informational market-implied probabilities and economic data; it places no trades, opens no accounts, shows no prices for our own products, and links only to informational pages on predictionmarketspicks.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 25 read-only prediction-market tools — Kalshi and Polymarket prices, NFL and NHL model reads, Fed and 15-minute commodity/crypto odds, Senate map, and expected-value, Kelly and probability calculators.
